messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "some patients have received treatment with pantoprazole for more than 2 years"
set: ["some patients have received treatment with pantoprazole for more than 2 years", "patients less than 3 years", "patients younger than 18 years old", "patients with severe allergic reaction after taking pantoprazole", "children younger than 2 years old", "pantoprazole", "pediatric patients younger than 6 years with type 1 diabetes", "pediatric patients less than 6 years old", "certain patients with type 2 diabetes", "pediatric patients with type 2 diabetes", "more than 1% of patients in clinical trials", "patients allergic to pantoprazole or similar medicines", "doses administered for more than 6 days have not been studied", "pantoprazole (oral/injection)", "type 2 diabetic patients", "some brands have different recommendations"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
